name: Flexion-intolerant back
note: Forward-bending under load may aggravate symptoms. Prefer supported or more upright options.

name: Shoulder impingement
note: Overhead or end-range pressing may aggravate symptoms. Prefer supported or lower-angle work.

name: Anterior knee pain
note: Deep knee bend under load may aggravate the front of the knee. Prefer shorter range or hip-dominant work.

name: Wrist pain
note: Extended-wrist front-rack or push-up positions may aggravate symptoms.

name: Elbow tendinopathy
note: Repeated curling or extending against load may aggravate the elbow. Reduce volume or switch implements.

name: Hypertension
note: Long breath-holds under heavy load raise blood pressure. Avoid coaching a Valsalva as the default.

name: Pregnancy
note: Supine loading, heavy Valsalva, and high-impact work need a clinician's plan. This catalog does not prescribe pregnancy training.

name: Recent shoulder surgery
note: Pressing and pulling need a clinician's clearance. Do not load the shoulder from the catalog alone.

name: Recent knee surgery
note: Squats, lunges and extensions need a clinician's clearance. Do not load the knee from the catalog alone.
